meta.rationale: A codec call that never ends: she is on the line on the right, the radio in the middle, your things on the left, and the conversation runs along the bottom like subtitles.
meta.theme-about: codec call: a black screen with a green radio unit at the top centre (PTT box, a frequency readout like 140.85 in big segment digits, a curved signal meter that swells while she talks, tuning arrows, a MEMORY box), her live portrait in a tall green-tinted scanline frame on the right, the apps as a quiet column of icons on the left, and the conversation itself along the bottom as white subtitle lines with a line to type on. Military radio, Metal Gear, nocturnal. (#radio, #face, #talk, #desk)

desktop.canvas: function draw(w, h, t) g.rect(0, 0, w, h, "#000000") for y = 0, h, 4 do g.rect(0, y, w, 1, "rgba(109,255,182,0.018)") end end

local G, D, B = "#6dffb6", "#0b3d27", "rgba(109,255,182," local function box(x, y, w, h, fill, edge) g.rect(x, y, w, h, fill) g.rect(x, y, w, 2, edge) g.rect(x, y + h - 2, w, 2, edge) g.rect(x, y, 2, h, edge) g.rect(x + w - 2, y, 2, h, edge) end function draw(w, h, t) local cx = w / 2 -- the frame lines either side, as on the unit g.rect(0, 30, w, 1, B .. "0.25)") g.rect(0, h - 30, w, 1, B .. "0.25)") -- PTT, lit box(cx - 100, 8, 200, 44, "#04160d", G) g.text(cx - 46, 16, "PTT", "#d8ffe9", 26, "JetBrainsMono") -- the screen local sx, sy, sw, sh = cx - 190, 96, 380, 250 box(sx, sy, sw, sh, "#010a06", B .. "0.6)") for i = 0, 3 do g.rect(sx + 14, sy + 14 + i * 22, sw - 28, 12, B .. (0.18 + 0.05 * i) .. ")") end -- the signal meter: a quarter curve of bars that swells and settles local level = 0.55 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 1.7) + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 5.3) for i = 0, 6 do local bw = 24 + i * 14 local on = i / 6 < level g.rect(sx + 18, sy + sh - 30 - i * 22, bw, 14, on and "#b8ffdc" or B .. "0.15)") end g.poly({sx + 110, sy + sh - 16, sx + sw - 16, sy + 96, sx + sw - 16, sy + sh - 16}, "#04140c") -- the frequency g.text(sx + 120, sy + 140, "140.85", "#b8ffdc", 64, "JetBrainsMono") -- tuning arrows g.poly({cx - 300, 220, cx - 250, 194, cx - 250, 246}, B .. "0.45)") g.poly({cx + 300, 220, cx + 250, 194, cx + 250, 246}, B .. "0.45)") -- MEMORY, dim box(cx - 120, h - 62, 240, 44, "#020c07", B .. "0.35)") g.text(cx - 76, h - 54, "MEMORY", B .. "0.55)", 24, "JetBrainsMono") end
